name: Visa-free entry to Dominica
summary: Citizens of many countries can enter without a visa. Commonwealth, CARICOM, the US and some European countries get up to six months. A second list gets up to three months. Others may get 21 days with a return ticket.

other: Official page groups countries by stay length but the full lists were not readable. Check your passport on the official page.
Up to 21 days for transit and bona fide tourists with a return ticket, if the immigration officer is satisfied.

stay.note: Up to 6 months, 3 months or 21 days depending on nationality.

sources.label: Government of Dominica: Do I need a visa to enter Dominica

name: Citizenship by Investment: Economic Diversification Fund contribution
summary: Get Dominican citizenship with a non-refundable contribution to the Economic Diversification Fund. You apply through an Authorised Agent. Citizenship is for life and can be passed down.

investment.note: Main applicant alone. 250,000 USD for main applicant plus up to three dependants. Each extra dependant under 18 adds 25,000 USD, and 18 or older adds 40,000 USD. Paid in USD, EUR or GBP.

other: Application must go through an Authorised Agent.
Needs proof of financial stability, a clean criminal record and a medical exam.
Dependants include spouse, children, parents and grandparents who rely on the main applicant.
Enhanced due diligence can apply depending on your current citizenship and circumstances.

fees.label: Interview fee, each applicant aged 16+, per interview

processing: CBIU says the process typically takes 3 to 6 months from submission to approval.
steps: Choose an Authorised Agent from the CBIU site.
Agent submits the application once due diligence fees are paid.
If approved in principle, pay the contribution and fees in full.
Receive citizenship and apply for a passport.

citizenship.note: CBIU lists the ability to hold multiple citizenships as a benefit. Your other country's rules still apply.

name: Citizenship by Investment: Approved real estate
summary: Get Dominican citizenship by buying a unit in a government-approved real estate project, plus government fees. You apply through an Authorised Agent.

investment.note: Minimum value of the approved property unit. Government fees are extra: 75,000 USD for the main applicant, 100,000 USD for main applicant plus up to three dependants, 25,000 USD per extra dependant under 18, 40,000 USD per extra dependant 18 or older.

other: Application must go through an Authorised Agent.
Property must be held 3 years from the date citizenship is granted, or 5 years if the buyer is also a CBI applicant.
Needs proof of financial stability, a clean criminal record and a medical exam.

fees.label: Government fee, main applicant plus up to three dependants

processing: CBIU says the process typically takes 3 to 6 months from submission to approval.
steps: Pick a project from the approved real estate list.
Choose an Authorised Agent from the CBIU site.
Agent submits the application once due diligence fees are paid.
If approved in principle, sign the Sale and Purchase Agreement and pay government fees.
Receive citizenship and apply for a passport.

citizenship.note: CBIU lists the ability to hold multiple citizenships as a benefit. Your other country's rules still apply.
